title: propose_agordo input
description: Turns a wish into visible movements of the sliders (Spec 019 ③, G6) — read-only, deterministic, no language model in the tool: the agent words it, the tool computes. Input: an Agordo, a wish in words (wunsch, German or English: ruhiger/calmer, kräftiger/bolder, wärmer/warmer, kühler/cooler, runder/rounder, eckiger/sharper, luftiger/airier, kompakter/denser, größer/larger, kleiner/smaller) and/or explicit slider values (regler: path → value, e.g. form.radius → 1.4, ikono.gewicht → bold). Answers with the new Agordo, the diff of the sliders, the report in short like preview_agordo, the sentence of the wish vocabulary that moved them and a link into the Werkstatt that shows the proposal before it holds. A wish the vocabulary does not know moves nothing: the answer asks back (action ask-human) and names the known words. A movement that would break a fixed rule stops before it. Writes nothing; save_agordo writes.

wunsch.description: The wish as said: „Mach die Marke ruhiger“, „runder und luftiger“, „make it calmer“.

regler.description: Explicit values by slider path (neutral.toenung, regler.*, form.*, raum.*, schrift.*) or ikono.gewicht.
